Gross Domestic Product United States

Gross domestic product (GDP) is the market value of goods and services produced by labor and property in the United States, regardless of nationality; GDP replaced gross national product (GNP) as the primary measure of U.S. production in 1991. Series are in billions of dollars and seasonally adjusted at annual rates.
